items.title: Magnitude 2.7 earthquake shakes North Bend area just before Great ShakeOut drill

items.body: A magnitude 2.7 earthquake struck near North Bend Wednesday evening, the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) confirmed. The earthquake’s epicenter was three miles southwest of Wilderness Rim. Thirty-eight people told USGS they felt the quake. Anyone who felt the earthquake is encouraged to report it on the USGS website. It occurred just after 6 p.m. Wednesday. The earthquake was about 10.5 miles deep. The earthquake happened just half a day before the worldwide Great ShakeOut earthquake and tsunami drill was set to take place. submitted by /u/TylerFortier_Photo [link] [comments]
